runs.text: The White Stripes are Jack White and Meg White. Formed in Southwest Detroit in 1997, the acclaimed rock duo released six studio albums with their simple guitar, drums and vocals approach – The White Stripes (1999), De Stijl (2000), White Blood Cells (2001), Elephant (2003) which includes global anthem “Seven Nation Army”, Get Behind Me Satan (2005), Icky Thump (2007), as well as The White Stripes Greatest Hits (2020).
